final: WITH per_acct_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id, AVG(t.amount) as avg_trans FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), region_avg AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, AVG(paa.avg_trans) as region_figure FROM per_acct_avg paa JOIN account a ON paa.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) as overall_avg FROM region_avg), above_avg_regions AS (SELECT r.region, r.region_figure FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE r.region_figure > oa.overall_avg), above_avg_figure AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) as avg_of_above_avg FROM above_avg_regions) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - oa.overall_avg as exceeds_avg, r.region_figure / aaf.avg_of_above_avg as ratio_to_above_avg_mean FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN above_avg_figure aaf WHERE r.region_figure > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY r.region
